en: A multi-view color postcard with a yellow border showing modern urban architecture in the city of Pécs. The front is divided into four photographs: the upper left shows a large white terraced modernist building with landscaped steps and people walking; the upper right shows a long, low white building with a red-tiled roof on a slope; the lower left and lower right images depict a sizeable commercial complex, with the word "KONZUM" on the facade, a glass-roofed section, parked cars, and pedestrians. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with printed stamp area, address lines, and Hungarian text indicating the city and publisher.
